author: GamingBolt
description:
Forza Horizon 6 is now a very short while away, and we’ve been having a blast putting this latest addition to the popular racing sim franchise through its paces. The good news is that it’s holding up quite well on both the PC and Xbox Series X, and it’s quite a stunning take on Japan. 

The even better news is that it performs as well as it looks. The bad news? There isn’t any. What’s made the Horizon Festival’s Japanese leg so visually enchanting? Join us as we take the game for a spin with you in the passenger seat (for now), and show you just how this version of Japan has had us itching to jump back into it for more almost constantly.
title: Forza Horizon 6 Graphics Analysis: An Absolute Masterclass In Visual Fidelity

author: GamingBolt
description:
After years of anticipation and a release pushed back multiple times – not to mention the ugly legal battles between its founders and Krafton – Unknown Worlds will launch Subnautica 2 into early access on May 14th. 

It will be available for Xbox Series X/S and PC alongside Game Pass, and in terms of features, changes, and improvements, it represents a far more ambitious experience than previous titles. Let's dive (no pun intended) into everything you should know, starting with the most important question: Where?
title: Subnautica 2 Early Access - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Playground Games has once again crafted a remarkable racing experience. The studio and the Forza Horizon franchise have reigned supreme over the racing genre for quite some time now, and with this newest entry, that dominance has been resolidified. 

Forza Horizon 6 doesn’t reinvent the wheel, no, but it shows once again just how good the series’ formula can be when it is firing on all cylinders – which it usually is – while also making good on massive potential of its long-awaited setting. If you enjoy a good racing game, this one cannot be missed.
title: Forza Horizon 6 Review - The Final Verdict
